details:
Q1: How will this issue get a trusted `files_touched` grant? Your answer alone cannot unblock it, because the guard reads only the issue body.
Choices:
A. A maintainer (OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR) edits this issue's body before `/approved` and adds a `files_touched:` block listing exactly `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh`, `.github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml`, `tests/test_check_failure_triage_workflow_security.py` and `changelog.d/6773-check-triage-pr-head-routing.md`. With `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true`, that is enough. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Same as A, but the block also lists `workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml` and `.github/workflows/internal-check-failure-triage.yml`, so the wrappers can pass the new flag explicitly. This is only needed if the reusable workflow's `vars.` default is not enough.
C. Proceed without a grant. **Note:** the implement guard will reject the commit again (`reason=no_allowlist`, `ai:scope-blocked`).
Q2: Final body validation rejects every `Integration branch:` line as `routing_key`. Where should the routed line go?
Choices:
A. Build the body with the line in place when the flag is on and the PR is verified. Validation then allows exactly one line, and only if it equals `Integration branch: <verified head ref>`. Any other routing key, a second such line, or a mismatched value is still rejected. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Run the current validation unchanged on the body without the line, then append the verified line afterwards. The tests must show that only the appended line can carry routing.
C. Literally insert the line before the current, unchanged validation. **Note:** every routed issue would then fail with `body_validation_failed reason=routing_key` (exit 1, CRITICAL), which contradicts the "exit 0 with a WARNING" requirement.
Q3: Which verified PR heads should get the Integration branch line when the flag is on?
Choices:
A. Any open, same-repository PR whose head ref is a valid branch name and whose head SHA matches the check's head SHA, including `ai/issue-<n>` and `orchestrator/project-<n>` heads. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Only `orchestrator/project-*` and other non-`ai/issue-*` heads. `ai/issue-*` PRs keep today's parent-issue lineage without a routing line.
C. Only heads that are not the repository's default branch (a head on the default branch gets no line, which is the same as today's behaviour).
Notes for the pipeline: no files were read beyond the triage script and the scope guard. No code was changed; this phase only asks questions.
